paragraphs: This register brings together research, versions and activations that may be interrupted, resumed, transformed or closed.
It does not describe a linear progression. It makes forms visible as they emerge, change state or remain open.

register.title: Published research
register.note: The public register is a curated selection. It does not reproduce the artist's private Kanban.

cards.title: The Summons of the Milieu
cards.summary: How can a local maritime signal summon an action, then produce a trace and an archive?
cards.opening: A milieu produces a signal. The signal summons an action. The response may be completed, delayed, prevented or refused. The research observes the gap between the signal and that response.
cards.evidence: A protocol to be tested. No constituted occurrence is published.

cards.title: Studies of the Ordinary
cards.summary: How can an ordinary action, actually carried out, produce a form without being embellished, dramatised or explained in advance?
cards.opening: A real everyday action is recorded, recounted and then examined. A question chosen by the artist opens an after-the-event poem and may lead to an HTML form.
cards.evidence: Three studies exist in the private archive. Their materials are not published here.

cards.title: Temporal Signatures
cards.summary: How do a date and time become a form, an identifier and a point of closure?
cards.opening: Seven documents dated from 2012 to 2026 show how timestamping, its separators and frames become visual forms.
cards.imageAlt: Detail of the inscription dated February 13, 2026 at 18:26, with date and time linked by an underscore
cards.caption: 2026-02-13 | 18:26. Partial view of the inscription, one of seven archival documents.

method.title: Each research project has its own temporality.
paragraphs: A work can be completed. Research may remain open, become interrupted, resume or give rise to another form.
States do not indicate degrees of success. The protocol makes visible the conditions, variations, passages and moments of closure.

criticalLegend.title: Distinguish what is documented from what remains to be tested.

entries.label: Documented fact
entries.text: An element supported by a document or an identified source, within the limits of that evidence.

entries.label: Interpretation
entries.text: A reading proposed from the documents, distinct from what they directly establish.

entries.label: Hypothesis
entries.text: A proposition or protocol to be tested.

entries.label: Unverified
entries.text: Information mentioned whose verification has not been established.

entries.label: Unknown
entries.text: Missing information or a question unanswered at this stage.

artist.title: Artist.
artist.text: His conceptual practice is built through research, gestures, protocols and situations. According to the needs of each work, it may draw on drawing, painting, photography, video, action or archival forms.

fibonacci.text: Each elapsed second advances one position in the sequence. The counter displays that index, not the value of the Fibonacci number. It places the site's continuous time alongside the discontinuous temporalities of research: its relevance remains to be tested through practice, without measuring productivity.
